name: taskflow
description: A production-shaped in-memory task queue whose choreographed 5-checkpoint history (T0 0.1.0 through T4 1.0.0, ~37 commits, 8 per update gap) stress-tests coverage, precision, and forgetting under a large, lifelike diff. Structural traps are graded model-free by the census: a MemoryStore-to-InMemoryStore rename with a file move, an experimental RedisStore feature reverted a checkpoint after it ships, a TaskError-to-TaskExecutionError rename with a deprecated alias, and a same-named TaskError resurrected with a new validation meaning in a new file. Three signature-stable bug fixes (LIFO-to-FIFO dequeue, batched-to-streaming worker pool, off-by-one retry backoff) flip behavior invisibly to the census and are reachable only as precision staleness, and a distributed-workers docstring at T4 is a code-authoritative hallucination. A transient clear() is added then reverted inside a gap.

checkpoints.label: taskflow 0.1.0 MVP: FIFO queue (latent LIFO bug), sequential worker, TaskError execution error
taskflow 0.2.0: FIFO fix, priority ordering, worker pool, MemoryStore
taskflow 0.3.0: retries, events, worker-pool fix, Store extracted with MemoryStore renamed to InMemoryStore
taskflow 0.4.0: Scheduler, DeadLetterQueue, experimental RedisStore, TaskError renamed to TaskExecutionError with alias, retry backoff fix
taskflow 1.0.0: RedisStore reverted, metrics, PersistentQueue, TaskError resurrected as a validation error, schedule retries default flip, distributed-workers doc lie
